note: Set A is better because it captures the specific terminology 'Phototrophic movement' without duplicating the actuation claim, whereas Set B redundantly extracts 'rotational movement' twice (claims 4 and 8). Set A also provides distinct claims for the Flexinol wire properties (trade name, material type), while Set B omits these specific entity definitions. Both sets suffer from duplicating the operable glazing percentage fact (claims 6 and 9 in both).
remarks: Both sets incorrectly label the 20% value as 'area' in one claim (A9, B9) when it is a proportion/percentage, and both duplicate this fact within their own sets. Set A's extraction of Flexinol wire properties is more faithful to the text's definition of the material.
